stops.title: Board no
stops.caption: Foforɔ, yɛredi akyi, wasakra.
stops.speech: Akra kwan yɛ board. Obi firi foforɔ kɔ yɛredi akyi kɔsi wasakra, na kɔla no kyerɛ sɛdeɛ nkitahodie no berɛ atwam.

stops.title: Yi obi kɔ anim
stops.caption: Twe no, anaa bue na sesa.
stops.speech: Twe kaad kɔ nsensaneɛ a ɛdi hɔ, anaa bue no na kyerɛw deɛ ɛsiiɛ na hyɛ nkɔdi akyi a ɛdi hɔ ɛda.
